## 🎯 Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a specific ergonomic challenge or musculoskeletal issue? (e.g. "I often suffer from lumbar tension when seated for long stretches...")

## 💡 Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it enhances the user experience.

## 🔬 Biomechanical & Technical Considerations
- Does this involve MediaPipe Pose landmark detection?
- Does it require local data persistence in `localStorage`?
- How should audio or visual feedback be handled?

## 🌟 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, or screenshots here.
